shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git ls-files && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ && grep -rl "refresh" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -30

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app; ls 03-api-reference/04-functions/; cat 03-api-reference/04-functions/refresh.md 2>/dev/null; grep -n -i "refresh" 02-guides/server-actions.md | head -40; cat /workspace/app/page.tsx /workspace/tsconfig.json; ls /workspace/app
cd /workspace && ls __agent_eval__ && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -6 && (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*'

cd /workspace; ID=$(grep -rhoE '"[0-9a-f]{40,}"' .next/server/server-reference-manifest.json | head -1 | tr -d '"'); echo "action=$ID"
curl -s -o /tmp/resp.txt -D - -X POST localhost:3123/ -H "Next-Action: $ID" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -H "Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8" --data '[]' | grep -iE '^(HTTP|location|x-action)'
grep -o 'Notifications are[^,]*' /tmp/resp.txt | head -2; grep -o '"on"\|"off"' /tmp/resp.txt | head
curl -s localhost:3123 | grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*'
pkill -f "next start"
cd /workspace; git status --short; git diff tsconfig.json; cat .gitignore
cd /workspace; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short
